evidence.detail: The class is constructed only by R85 DepthBufferedImageSurface from its first software-surface blit path and is submitted directly to SwingUtilities.invokeLater.
run() selects one of two exact launcher JFrame sizes (1134x537 or 1312x800), applies the size, reads the current screen dimensions and centers the frame on screen.
Under the same wide-layout state it makes the launcher frame visible and, when the physical screen width is narrower than the requested wide frame, sets the JFrame extended state to 6.
The task stores only its synthetic DepthBufferedImageSurface owner and performs no raster, packet, gameplay or persistent UI-service work beyond this deferred frame setup.

proposals.note: Descriptive exact-v308 name for the one-shot EDT launcher-frame setup task spawned by DepthBufferedImageSurface.
